Draft revised addressing all 7 audit findings: T2-engine now owns both inflections + shared primitives + calculator extension contract; principle 3 scoped to public capabilities with privileged/raw-data exclusions; security surfaces assigned distinctly (authn=platform, authz/blindness=data-layer, agent credentials=agent-distribution); activation metric (completed two-party reconciliations) named in Success and principle 7; mechanism/inventory detail moved down to T2 altitude; raw-data rule restated as a disclosure boundary permitting data-subject access; background references given canonical paths and exact filenames; Q1/Q2/Q4 reworded to remove ancestry contradictions. attributes.summary: Audit-before-acceptance round 1: delegated via clink/codex (exfu-auditor, read-only, gpt-5.6-sol), 1 round, return salvage needed. Verdict: revise — 2 high (redaction seam contradicted T1 theme boundary; role-model HITL reopened T1's toy-is-a-template ruling), 4 medium (survey contract too vague to bind a T3, primitives partition overclaimed, numeric domain unruled, honesty signals undefined), 1 low (no version metadata on results). Full return: .exfu/returns/t2-engine-audit-r1.json.

Draft revised addressing all 7 findings: engine results declared trusted-internal with field classification and a no-deal disclosure contract (data-layer alone builds role-safe payloads); role model bound to two directional roles with T1-amendment escalation path; normative survey algorithm contract added (curve construction, interpolation, interval/no-crossing states, per-respondent validation, edge-case vectors); primitives partitioned engine-wide/toolkit/inflection-specific with a consumption map; numeric domain fixed (finite, positive, one currency, zero-width defined); honesty signals given versioned definitions; version metadata required on every result. HITL now Q1 tolerance semantics, Q2 money representation, Q3 small-sample threshold. Status remains draft — awaiting operator acceptance.
